label: space-wheel-zoom
js: (() => { const select=document.querySelector('[data-testid=zoom-level]'); if(!select) return 'no-zoom-control'; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(select,'1'); select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); const v=document.querySelector('[data-testid=workspace-viewport]'); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:' ',code:'Space',bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); v?.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,deltaY:-100,deltaMode:0})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:' ',code:'Space',bubbles:true})); return document.querySelector('[data-testid=zoom-level]')?.value })()
